title: Memory costs and AI shopping agents force us to rethink price and reach
summary: Samsung sees the memory shortage lasting to 2028 and Apple forecasts a holiday margin drop; Amazon added 100+ Alexa shopping functions, Walmart upgraded Sparky; Visa found AI fails 43% of shopping tests.

points.headline: Memory inflation squeezes PC margins into 2028
points.detail: Samsung expects the memory shortage to last through 2028, Apple forecasts a margin drop and mobile SoC shipments fall nearly 20%. We should plan pricing and promotions around component costs.

points.headline: Retail AI assistants are becoming a discovery and checkout layer
points.detail: Amazon added 100+ Alexa functions and text access; Walmart added cart generation to Sparky. We should make our listings and feeds readable by these assistants.

points.headline: Agent checkout is promising but still unreliable
points.detail: Visa found AI models fail 43% of shopping test runs while Mastercard forms OpenAI and Tencent partnerships. We should test how agents handle our store.

points.headline: Apple plans a big laptop volume push
points.detail: Apple told suppliers to plan 16M MacBook Neo units in 2027, double 2026. We should expect pricing and promo pressure in entry-level notebooks.

points.headline: Marketplace costs rise as new channels emerge
points.detail: Amazon seller fees and ads reached $66.1B in Q3, and TikTok launched a stand-alone Shop app. We should weigh channel margins against growing our own store.
